recipes.name: Peach–Grand Marnier Flan Pâtissier
recipes.desc: Vanilla-bean flan pâtissier layered with peaches caramelized in butter, sugar, orange zest and Grand Marnier.
ingredients: 500 ml whole milk (or 400 ml milk + 100 ml cream)
method: Caramelize peaches with butter, sugar, orange zest and Grand Marnier.
Temper yolks and cook the vanilla custard on the stove until very thick.
Layer custard → peaches → custard → remaining peaches.
recipes.notes: Signature first entry. Add whole-flan, cut-slice and process photographs.

recipes.name: Grand Marnier Madeleines
recipes.desc: Browned-butter madeleines developed around Grand Marnier, orange, honey and overnight maturation.
method: Build the batter gently without excessive aeration.
Flavor with vanilla, citrus and Grand Marnier; v2 incorporates honey.
Bake cold batter in prepared madeleine molds until humped and deeply golden.
recipes.notes: Lineage: v1.0 12-piece formulation; v1.1 no-leavener experiment; v2.0 24-piece Grand Marnier–Honey overnight version.

recipes.name: Canelés de Bordeaux
recipes.desc: Vanilla canelés developed through flour, mold, maturation and high-heat caramelization experiments.
method: Reduce to 190°C / 375°F and bake 45–60 minutes, judging by deep caramelization.
recipes.notes: Keep the imperfect batch in the experiment record: dramatic rise, overflow/collapse, pale shell, then corrective caramelization.

recipes.name: Tarte Bourdaloue — Ayala Variation
recipes.desc: Pear-and-almond tart with vanilla, Seville orange, Grand Marnier and dark-rum poached pears.
ingredients: Pâte sucrée: ~150 g flour, 113 g butter, 40 g powdered sugar, 1 yolk
Frangipane: 113 g butter, 100 g sugar, 100 g almond flour, 2 eggs
method: Poach pears gently with vanilla, orange and liqueurs; drain well.
Bake until almond filling is set and deeply golden.
recipes.notes: Preserve the Ayala poaching variation rather than normalizing it to a generic Bourdaloue.
